title: Show the time each chat message was sent
prompt:
Chat views do not show when a message was sent. Show a compact local time under each message, with the full date and time available by keyboard or tap, across local, cloud and phone chats.

The event's existing `ts` cannot be trusted as a send time: an older runtime imported whole multi-day conversations in one batch, so their `ts` is the import time. Add a separate, verified `messageTs` to agent events (Rust `AgentEvent.message_ts`, serialized as `messageTs` and omitted when absent; and in `@terminalx/portable/events`). Record it at the source: the message's own time for imported transcripts, the send time for prompts, and the first text chunk's time for streamed replies. Legacy records without `messageTs` show no time; never infer one from `ts`, and leave their `ts` as it was.

Shared (packages/portable/src/transcript.ts):
- Carry `messageTs` onto the turn's prompt, onto text work items, and onto queued and mid-turn message items. A queued message keeps its own time when the agent absorbs it or when it becomes the next prompt; when it has none, the prompt's `messageTs` stays empty rather than borrowing another time.
- Export `messageTime(ts?, locales?, timeZone?)` returning `{ short, full, iso }` or `undefined`. `short` uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `timeStyle: "short"`, `full` uses `dateStyle: "full", timeStyle: "long"`. Only ISO strings with an explicit zone (Z or ±hh:mm) count; empty, invalid or zoneless values are unknown.

Desktop:
- src/components/chat/MessageTime.tsx exports `MessageTime({ ts })`: nothing for an unknown time; otherwise a native `<details>` whose `<summary>` is focusable, has aria-label `Message time: <full>` and contains `<time dateTime={iso}>{short}</time>`, and which expands to the full date.
- TurnBlock shows one MessageTime per prompt, reply text and mid-turn message, from `messageTs` only, the same with or without a cwd and after a reload.
- In src/lib/agentEvents.ts, a streaming text block keeps the `messageTs` of its first text chunk; a queued user message must not clear the stream (only a non-queued one or turn end does); the time survives commit, merge and reload.

Phone (mobile/src/ui/transcript-rows.ts): each `TurnRow` gains an optional `ts`, set only on the first row of a prompt, reply or mid-turn message when it is split into chunks; queued rows keep their `messageTs` only on the first chunk. Show the time in the phone's transcript.

check.run: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/chat/MessageTime.test.tsx src/lib/agentEvents.timestamps.test.ts

notes: Modules touched by the change: src-tauri (events gain a verified message time; harness and session record it), packages/portable (events and transcript), mobile/src (transcript rows), src/lib and src/components/chat (desktop chat). Check: vitest, 2.0 s failing at the start, 1.7 s passing measured by check-task on 2026-11-12 (a fresh pnpm install adds 8 to 17 s; a cached one about 1 s). Start is the merge's first parent; solution is the merge commit.
